verdict.rationale: Cekura ships a full OpenAPI spec, CLI, and SDK that cover core workflows—managing agents, scenarios, runs, call data, sending calls, and metrics—giving strong programmatic parity with the UI (cekura-docs-4, cekura-docs-5, cekura-docs-6, cekura-probe-3, cekura-probe-5). However, some UI-specific features like custom dashboard building (cekura-docs-11) and cron/CI setup aren't clearly confirmed as fully API-driven rather than UI-configured. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that dashboard creation and all UI-configurable settings are exposed via API/CLI, and independent verification of complete feature parity.
